name: Coccinea
source:
Kamen Rider Dragon Knight and Puella Magi Madoka Magica crossover. Because of a game set up by someone powerful, Kit Taylor’s and Kyouko Sakura’s fortunes intertwined. Rated T for violence and suggestive themes. 

[From [url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]DagitabSoft[/url]]
translation:
假面骑士龙骑士与魔法少女小圆联动。因为一场权贵所设下的游戏，基特·泰勒和佐仓杏子的命运交织在一起。暴力和暗示性主题被评为T级。

[来自[url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]达吉塔软件[/url]]
